title: Docker: image lacks the `openai` package, and the Ollama docs point at localhost (harshithkantamneni/obsidian-engine)
raw_text:
Docker: image lacks the `openai` package, and the Ollama docs point at localhost — open-source issue in harshithkantamneni/obsidian-engine. Labels: bug, documentation, good first issue. Using Ollama through the `openai` LLM provider does not work from the Docker image, for two reasons:

title: GenAI RAG Tutorial Build PDF Question Answering System with FAISS & OpenAI using LangChain Framework
author: Mithilesh yadav
raw_text: In this GenAI and LangChain RAG tutorial, we will build a complete PDF Question Answering system using LangChain, OpenAI ...
summary: This youtube tutorial guides you through building a complete pdf question-answering system using retrieval-augmented generation (rag). it leverages the langchain framework, openai's language models, and faiss for efficient similarity search. you'll learn how to process pdf documents, create embeddings, store them in a vector database like faiss, and then retrieve relevant information to augment llm responses. this project is a fantastic way to see how multiple genai components come together to solve a real-world problem. understanding this workflow is key for developing intelligent applications. you could follow this tutorial to build your own pdf q&a system, gaining hands-on experience with rag and langchain.
why: Hands-on RAG tutorial, combining LLMs, LangChain, and vector databases for practical use.
